romanized_text:
shahar ke bichon-bicha ek bahut purani pustakalay thi. log kahate the ki vahan ki kuch kitaben sau sal se bhi adhik purani hain. din men vahan chatron aur shodhakartaon ki bhida lagi rahati thi, lekin sham hote hi pura bhavan shant ho jata tha.

ek din arav nam k chatr itihas ki pariyojan ke lie samagri khojane vahan gaya. use ek dhul se dhaki hui alamari mili, jo samanyatah band rahati thi. alamari ke bhitar use chamadae ke kavar vali ek dayari dikhai di. dayari ke pahale panne para likha tha, jo bhi ise padhae, vaha saty ki khoj puri kare.

arav utsuk ho gaya. usane dayari padhana shuru kiya. usamen shahar ke ek bhule-bisare vyapari k ullekh tha, jisane varshon pahale kai garib parivaron ki madad ki thi, lekin usak nam itihas men kahin darj nahin tha. dayari men kuch sanket aur purane nakshe bhi bane hue the.

agale kai dinon tak arav un sanketon k pich karat rah. antatah use nagar abhilekhagar men aise dastaveja mile jinhonne vyapari ki kahani ko saty siddh kara diya. usaki khoj ke bad nagar parishad ne us vyakti ke samman men ek smarak sthapit kiya.

arav ne sikh ki itihas keval badai ghatanaon k nahin, balki un logon k bhi hota hai jinake achche kary samay ke sath bhul die jate hain.
